violation_type.title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §744.1005(a)(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: There is no program director or site director present at the operation to supervise employees.

finding_variants.text: There is no program director or site director present at the operation to supervise employees.

A child who had food allergies and an epi pen was in a group run by a substitute.  The substitute was unaware of any children in his group having allergies.     The Director did not convey important information to the Site Director, which led to the second incident of inappropriate touching of a child.
At the time of the inspection the caregiver did not know the designated program director. The caregiver named a different person as being their program director that is assigned to different sites.
At the time of the inspection the staff present stated their program director and direct supervisor was a different person than the one designated to Childcare Regulation.
The chain of command was discussed with the persons on site. The program director assigned is not overseeing the day to day operations of the site.
At the time inspection the program director had not been on site or in communication with the person left in charge since the site director had left their role in January 2026.
